name: Lofi player
author: Jordan Kicklighter
description: Bar widget for the lofi-player script: play, pause, stop, volume, favorites, and a picker for live streams from your channels. Offers to install lofi when it isn't on your PATH.

barWidget.description: Left-click opens the player, right-click plays or pauses, middle-click stops, scroll changes volume.

schema.label: Show volume next to the icon
